title: plan.json
description: Top-level plan file. Experiments are independent (each restarts the server) and are iterated in order. Outer grouping is by dataset: all server_configs for one dataset run before moving to the next dataset.

search_space_axes.description: Ordered list of server_flag axes swept in this run. Used by the report to pick columns for the server_config table.

server_configs.description: One entry per unique server config. Lets the report show each server_config_id's flag values keyed by search_space_axes.

flags.description: Full resolved flag map for this config (base + axis overrides).

experiment_id.description: Unique, monotonically assigned at plan generation time.

serve_cmd.description: Full shell command to start the SGLang server (run via SSH, backgrounded by runner).

bench_cmd.description: Full shell command to run the benchmark (includes --output-file pointing at a remote path).

cleanup_cmd.description: Optional. Full shell command (run via SSH) to tear down the server started by serve_cmd. Covers docker / python / custom launchers uniformly. If absent, the runner falls back to kill $PID + lsof -ti:$PORT.

output_file.description: Local path where the wrapped result JSON is written after scp.

server_config_id.description: Stable id for a unique server flag combination. Shared across experiments that only differ in dataset/concurrency.
